description: This file contains unit test code for the 'guardrails' component within the 'litellm.proxy' package. It tests the initialization of a guardrail handler using the InMemoryGuardrailHandler class, verifying its behavior with preset guardrail parameters, specifically for the SupportedGuardrailIntegrations.PRESIDIO implementation.

classes.name: InMemoryGuardrailHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing guardrail instances in memory, providing initialization functionality.

methods.name: test_initialize_presidio_guardrail()
methods.description: A test function that verifies the correct initialization of a presdioguardrail via the InMemoryGuardrailHandler.
